description: Get the TV broadcast schedule for a specific country and date — lists all episodes airing that day with show name, network/channel, air time, season/episode numbers, and ratings. Supports broadcast TV (default) or streaming/web channels (Netflix, Hulu, etc.). Country: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (US, GB, AU, CA, DE, etc.). Date: YYYY-MM-DD (defaults to today). No auth required. Source: TVmaze.com (CC BY-SA).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code for broadcast TV schedule (e.g. "US", "GB", "AU"). Omit for global.

date.description: Schedule date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. "2026-06-29"). Defaults to today.

streaming.description: If true, returns streaming/web channel schedule (Netflix, Hulu, etc.) instead of broadcast TV. Default: false

name: tvmaze.schedule.broadcast

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: TV Broadcast Schedule
